entries.subject: Selected source model
entries.finding: Authored ellipsoid approximation constrained to the published convex model's maximum extents. These are not independently measured ellipsoid axes; the irregular convex outline and model volume are not reproduced. Full approximation dimensions: 77.5 × 71.3 × 61.8 km. Published retrograde pole, with an arbitrary display meridian. The approximation has no qualified current surface longitude. The grid marks unmapped terrain. Source: [Mottola et al. (2023), The Planetary Science Journal 4, 18, Table 3](https://elib.dlr.de/194154/1/Mottola%20et%20al%202023_shapes%20of%20Eurybates%20and%20Orus.pdf). Checked 2026-09-08. The full axes are halved once; the reference radius is the geometric mean of these semiaxes. This is the approximation's rendering scale, not an independent observed radius or the volume of the original convex reconstruction. Formal axis uncertainties are included only where the source supplies them.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: This review did not locate or qualify reusable surface imagery registered to the selected reconstruction. Disk-integrated photometry and DAMIT model metadata are not surface maps.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: The checked paper describes a 1454-facet direct facet-area convex reconstruction and its occultation scale, but this review did not find a released numerical mesh in its linked/supporting material. The rendered ellipsoid remains a maximum-extents approximation, not a numerical replacement mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: Lucy mission and model references
entries.finding: The 2025 Lucy mission summary remains a contextual cross-reference in the checked source record. This metadata review did not use it to newly qualify geometry, a surface product, or rotational phase.

entries.subject: DAMIT model catalogue coverage
entries.finding: The cached 2026-09-13 official DAMIT asteroid/model/reference CSV exports were joined by exact asteroid name and contained no Eurybates row with a listed model. This is bounded coverage of that export, not evidence that no numerical model exists elsewhere.
entries.revisitWhen: A future DAMIT export lists Eurybates, or another release provides a numerical model with documented frame, scale and terms.
